target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory
f=finite_spectral_shadows
for pass in 1 2 3; do pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error $f.tex >/tmp/$f.log 2>&1; done
echo "exit=$?"
grep -iE "^!|undefined control|Reference .* undefined|Citation .* undefined|multiply defined|cref reference" /tmp/$f.log | sort -u | head
grep -ciE "Overfull \\\\hbox \\([1-9][0-9]{2}" /tmp/$f.log | xargs echo "big overfulls:"
pdfinfo $f.pdf 2>/dev/null | grep Pages
rm -f $f.aux $f.out $f.toc $f.log
